protocol.note: Protocol fixed before this supplementary run, after observing original article; not original study preregistration.
protocol.criterion: For all four indices: absolute change of across-scramble mean N128 to N256 <=0.03 AND t CI halfwidth across four independent scrambles at N256 <=0.05. Numerical diagnostic only, not mathematical proof.
protocol.policy_analysis: Exploratory fixed-policy comparison; no winner selected as confirmatory. Marginal paired t intervals across 30 common seeds; no claims of clinical fairness thresholds.
protocol.original_reproduction: 450 historical rows, all numerical metrics excluding runtime_s, absolute tolerance 1e-8
